answer_1.quote: We propose FIN-FORCE -FINancial FORward Counterfactual Evaluation, a novel benchmark to support LLM forward counterfactual generation in finance.

answer_2.quote: We build on perplexity for fluency evaluation by focusing on ∆ Perplexity - the difference between the average perplexity of all counterfactuals and all original headlines... we introduce two new metrics—forward-compatibility and directionality, which are better aligned with FIN-FORCE's objectives.

answer_3.quote: Each counterfactual is assessed using an LLM-as-a-judge framework... we validate the LLM judgments through a human-LLM agreement study

answer_4.quote: Five human contributors, all based in Singapore and recruited from reputable research institutions, participated in the benchmark annotation... we conducted a human-LLM agreement study
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluated whether a headline describes a financial market event based on Event Status and Material Relevance criteria; for counterfactuals, they assessed Forward-Compatibility and Directionality using detailed guidelines.
